title: Richardson Attention: Superconducting Spectral Attention and Renormalization Group Relays for Zero-Shot Multi-Hop Extrapolation in Pre-Trained Transformers
description: Zero-training spectral attention extrapolation, Write/Read asymmetric query-slice gating, SWA decoy shielding, and depth-progressive Renormalization Group (RG) relays for 1-to-5 hop long-context pointer chasing in hybrid Transformers (Gemma-4 2B & 4B).
